decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith (KS/01B received 01.09.11, KS/02B received 07.09.11, KS/03C and KS/04C received 25.11.11..) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in either flank wall of the roof extensions hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The roof light on the east facing roof slope shall be obscure glazed and non-opening and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
description: Erection of a side roof extension to the western side of the main roof slope to the house and one roof light.
